issues.description: `Bookstore.books` is declared `private` in the solution (`Bookstore.swift`), but `Client.main()` iterates over `bookstore.books` (`Client.swift`). This is a compile-time access control error and contradicts the problem statement’s requirement that `Bookstore` “holds an array of `Book`s named `books`” intended for inventory printing/testing.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the `books` array readable from `Client` (and tests) by changing `private let books: [Book]` to `let books: [Book]` (module-internal) or `public private(set) var books: [Book]`, or provide a non-private read-only accessor (e.g., `var books: [Book] { booksStorage }`) and update `Client` to use it.
